title: We are Frontline AIDS
slide_intent: Bring a sequence of campaign declarations back to the speaker. A simple reveal makes clear whose voice the reader has been hearing.
strategic_value: The organization can make its name memorable by giving it the same assertive treatment as the preceding declarations.
demonstration: The name appears as stacked black type on a pink box against green. A black dot grid, cyan loop and cyan arrow direct attention toward the name.
practical_value: Use this graphic interlude when the sequence needs to identify the organization in its own words.

content_islands.name: Pattern field
content_islands.spec: Place a field of black dots across the upper-left portion of the green page.

content_islands.name: Name and gesture
content_islands.spec: Set the name in a pink rectangle right of center. Wrap it with the cyan line and direct the arrow toward the rectangle.
